server.description: Comma-separated list of Zabbix server IP addresses (or hostnames) allowed to connect to this agent for passive checks.

server_active.description: Comma-separated list of Zabbix server IP addresses (or hostnames) for active checks. Defaults to `server` if not specified.

hostname.description: Unique hostname of this host as configured on the Zabbix server.

enable_active_checks.description: Enable sending主动 checks to the server (requires `server_active`).

buffer_send.description: Time (seconds) to wait before sending unsent data to server.

buffer_size.description: Maximum number of unsent data lines to buffer.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous incoming connections for passive checks.

include_dir.description: Directory containing additional `.conf` files with user parameters and settings.

log_remote_commands.description: Log level for remote commands execution (0–4). Higher values increase logging verbosity.

enable_remote_commands.description: Allow the server to execute arbitrary commands on this agent. Disabled by default for security.

tls_enable.description: Enable TLS encryption for agent communications (requires Zabbix server with TLS support).

psk_identity.description: PSK identity string used in TLS-PSK handshake.

psk_file.description: Path to the PSK file (must exist and have correct permissions).

user_parameters.description: List of custom user-defined parameters (e.g., monitoring scripts).

enabled.description: Whether to include this parameter in the config.

name.description: Descriptive name of this user parameter.

key.description: The metric key (must be unique; e.g., `app.status`)

command.description: Shell command to execute (supports Zabbix macro expansion).

debug_level.description: Debug level (0–5); only set temporarily for troubleshooting (overlays LogRemoteCommands).

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for incoming agent connections.

listen_ip.description: IP address(es) to bind to. Use `127.0.0.1` to restrict to localhost only.

start_agents.description: Number of pre-forked agent processes (0 disables passive checks).
